narr: Scattered thunderstorms resulted in heavy rain and flash flooding across southeast Virginia on June 25.
ev: The westbound left shoulder, left lane, left center lane, and right center lane were closed due to standing water on interstate 264.
Tatemstown Road was reported to be underwater.
Midtown tunnel was flooded due to heavy rain.
